name: @devup-ui/metro-plugin
description: Devup UI for React Native: compiles Devup UI to React Native styles in Metro (experimental)
author: devfive

scripts.build: bun ../../node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc && bun build --target node src/index.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/index.cjs --format cjs --packages external --define import.meta.url=module.filename && bun build --target node src/index.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --packages external && bun build --target node src/transformer.ts --production --env=disable --outfile dist/transformer.cjs --format cjs --packages external --define import.meta.url=module.filename
